record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との接続または一般化可能なLLM推論効率効果が弱く、具体的な追加検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 RobustKV evicts low-ranked KV entries to suppress jailbreak tokens and evaluates attack resistance and benign-task quality. The paper uses cache eviction, but its objective is safety; it does not establish cache-capacity, latency or throughput gains for serving.
record.title: RobustKV: Defending Large Language Models against Jailbreak Attacks via KV Eviction
